measurement.endpoint: input dispatch to second requestAnimationFrame; not compositor presentation
measurement.exclusions: latency, component timings and function counters require document-visible buckets entirely after their marker; hidden/focus-only and marker-boundary buckets excluded
measurement.componentTimings: root React Profiler actualDuration plus chained development Fiber metadata; render phase only; not layout/paint or total commit work
measurement.renderCalls: injected function-entry calls; includes development Strict Mode double invocation; not committed renders
measurement.overhead: observerMs measures the Fiber walk; snapshotMs measures snapshot creation; neither accounts for all instrumentation overhead
measurement.memory: recorded separately from OS samples; no JavaScript heap API assumption
